_comment: Editorial content for CSAP. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility exists on the open licence sources, and a generic industry photo would imply it is theirs.
description: Crescent Steel and Allied Products Limited began commercial operations in March 1987 with a line pipe plant and now runs businesses in engineering, textiles, capital markets and power across six sites. Its steel business makes large-diameter submerged arc welded helical seam (SAWH) carbon steel pipe and coatings — more than 10,000 km supplied to the national energy transmission network — alongside a billet unit; its cotton unit, Crescent Cotton Products, spins carded cotton and synthetic yarn at Jaranwala.
headOffice: 9th Floor, SIDCO Avenue Centre, 264 R.A. Lines, Karachi
